adjudication.evidence: P1 (426–429) shows a small, transient N/E shift but no clear return; U shows a large drop at 430–431 not aligned with P1’s end. P2 (433) is a single-point spike in E/U with no sustained offset or return—likely noise or isolated jump. The dominant feature is a large, abrupt U drop at ~430–431 (index 430–431), followed by persistent lower level; this resembles a permanent step, not a temporary platform. No candidate pair exhibits a sustained shift + opposing return across same axes. Interior observations during P1/P2 do not support a genuine temporary platform.
